title: Nourishing Juicy Jamaican Mulukhiyah Stew
description: A sweet and juicy Jamaican stew featuring mulukhiyah, shio-koji-cure, and raw-friendly ingredients, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner.
instructions: Heat the shio-koji in a large pot over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the mulukhiyah leaves, scotch bonnet pepper, salt, and black pepper to the pot, stirring well to combine.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional mulukhiyah leaves if desired.
